title: Chapter 8 Quiz
description: Test your knowledge of methods, parameters, return values, overloading, and Unity's event functions!

questions.question: What is the main purpose of a method?
options: To group a block of reusable code under a name
questions.explanation: Methods encapsulate reusable logic.

questions.question: What does 'void' indicate in a method signature?
options: The method does not return any value
questions.explanation: void means no return value.

questions.question: Which of the following is a correct method call?
questions.explanation: Methods are called using parentheses.

questions.question: What is the difference between a parameter and an argument?
options: Parameter is the definition, argument is the value passed
Argument is the definition, parameter is the value passed
There is no argument in C#
questions.explanation: Parameters are placeholders; arguments are actual values.

questions.question: How do you make a parameter optional?
options: Give it a default value in the method declaration
Put a question mark after the type
questions.explanation: Default values make parameters optional.

questions.question: What keyword is used to send a value back from a method?
questions.explanation: return exits the method and provides a value.

questions.question: What must the return type of a method be if it returns a number like 3.14?
questions.explanation: 3.14 is a float literal; the method must return float.

questions.question: A method can have multiple return statements.
questions.explanation: Yes, as long as all code paths return a value of the correct type.

questions.question: What is method overloading?
options: Having too many methods in a class
Defining multiple methods with the same name but different parameters
Calling a method from another method
questions.explanation: Overloading uses the same name, different parameter lists.

questions.question: Which of these is a valid overload of 'void Attack(int damage)'?
questions.explanation: Different parameter type (float vs int) makes it a valid overload.

questions.question: You can overload a method by changing only its return type.
questions.explanation: Return type alone is not enough; parameter signatures must differ.

questions.question: When is Awake() called relative to Start()?
options: Only when the object is disabled
questions.explanation: Awake runs before Start.

questions.question: Which method should you use for Rigidbody physics?
questions.explanation: FixedUpdate is called on a timer synced with the physics engine.

questions.question: What is the typical use of LateUpdate?
questions.explanation: LateUpdate runs after all Update calls, perfect for follow cameras.

questions.question: Which method is called when a GameObject becomes active?
questions.explanation: OnEnable is called each time the object is enabled.

questions.question: What is a guard clause?
options: An early return that exits a method if conditions are not met
questions.explanation: Guard clauses validate input at the top and return early if invalid.

questions.question: How can you skip remaining parameters when calling a method with optional parameters?
questions.explanation: Named arguments allow you to specify only the parameters you want to override.

questions.question: Which keyword allows a variable number of arguments of the same type?
questions.explanation: params lets you pass a comma-separated list or array.

questions.question: What does Debug.Log return?
questions.explanation: Debug.Log() is a void method; it doesn't return a value.

questions.question: In a method with return type bool, what happens if not all code paths return a value?
questions.explanation: All paths must return a bool; otherwise the compiler will throw an error.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT a built-in Unity event method?
questions.explanation: OnPlayerJoined is not a standard MonoBehaviour message; it might be from networking.

questions.question: Can you have a method that returns a GameObject?
questions.explanation: Return types can be any valid type, including GameObject.

questions.question: What is the benefit of having an overload that calls another overload?
questions.explanation: One overload can delegate to a more comprehensive one, keeping logic in one place.

questions.question: FixedUpdate is called at the same frame rate as Update.
questions.explanation: FixedUpdate has a fixed timestep independent of frame rate; Update runs once per rendered frame.
